text:
alex: kicking off tulip7b quant bench — target int8 + q4f (fused4) on rtx-a100-dedicated. sweep batches [1,4,8], ctx [512,2048]. I'll post quick smokes and artifacts as they land.
benchbot: queued job tulip7b | quant=int8 | hw=rtx-a100 | id=jb-9123
alex: smoke int8 batch=1 ctx=512 -> p50=25.9ms p95=46.1ms tok/s=178 mem=22.1GB
claire: can you capture cold vs warmed KV cache and a prefix-reuse case? those matter a lot for PLG flows.
alex: yep adding cold/warm + prefix reuse runs. kicking off fused q4f smoke now.
benchbot: fused-q4f smoke complete: batch=1 ctx=512 p50=17.6ms p95=35.0ms tok/s=265 mem=16.2GB note="no NaN observed"
tobias: please include decoder timeline from the profiler (embed/attn/ffn breakdown) for each run.
alex: profiler traces attached to artifacts; will annotate hotspots.
maya: reminder: run the quality-regression (qreg) suite vs fp16 baseline — summ/inst-follow + hallucination/factuality probes.
alex: quick qreg (1.2k prompts) results: int8 rouge-L delta = -0.7, q4f rouge-L delta = -2.1; q4f hallucination +12% (prelim)
claire: q4f drop is concerning. try hybrid-last2-fp16 or mixed-last4 to preserve quality.
alex: launching mixed-last4 and vocab-remap warm-start variants.
benchbot: mixed-last4 run finished: batch=4 ctx=2048 p50=40.2ms p95=84.7ms tok/s=310 mem=17.6GB
alex: mixed-last4 qreg delta = -0.3 rouge-L; hallucination rate ~baseline.
tobias: nice. prioritization for deeper validation: 1) mixed-last4, 2) int8, 3) q4f. gating criteria: rouge-L delta >= -0.5 AND hallucination <= 2x baseline.
ingrid: add an end-to-end (gateway) latency check including auth + routing overhead — SLO is 200ms p95 for single-turn chat.
alex: gateway e2e mixed-last4 batch=1 ctx=512 -> p95=171ms (includes routing/auth). passes e2e SLO for 1-turn.
claire: pre-onboard checklist (must be green before we mark onboard-ready):
- perf: full grid sweep (batch 1,4,8 x ctx 512,2048)
- perf: cold vs warm KV cache + prefix-reuse series
- quality: full qreg + hallucination/factuality breakdown vs fp16
- stability: 24h smoke on prod-like pool
- infra: quant kernel fallback matrix + flags documented
- docs: model profile (latency/cost tradeoffs) + recommended default config and runbook
alex: i'll own perf + 24h stability. tobias will own the kernel fallback matrix. maya/ingrid take qreg/docs respectively.
maya: taking qreg — will upload full artifact set and diffs.
ingrid: drafting profile doc and example config now. example config snippet:
```
model: tulip-7b
quant: mixed-last4
batch_sizes: [1,4,8]
ctx_lengths: [512,2048]
fallback_priority: [int8, fp16]
metrics_to_monitor: [p50,p95,tokens_per_sec,rouge-L,hallucination_rate]
```
alex: ETA for full pass: end of day tomorrow. uploading logs here: https://internal.redwood/bench/jb-9123
benchbot: job jb-9123 artifacts uploaded -> https://internal.redwood/bench/artifacts/jb-9123.tar.gz
tobias: let's schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to finalize gating and rollout plan once artifacts are in.
claire: lgtm :thumbsup:
alex: thanks everyone — i'll close the intake once PR + qreg artifacts are green and the docs PR is merged.
